about: Drummondville is in Centre-du-Québec, on the rivière Saint-François between Montréal and Québec City. It grew around mills and textile plants and is now a regional industrial and service city on Autoroute 20. The Village Québécois d’Antan is the best-known heritage site. About 79,000 people live in Drummondville.
